# Antibiotic Prophylaxis for Placement of Percutaneous Gastrostomy (PEG) Tube

Antibiotics are recommended for all patients prior to placement of PEG tube to reduce the risk of peristomal wound infection.

References:

- Up-to-Date website
- Guideline: Antibiotic prophylaxis for GI endoscopy, Gastrointestinal
- Endoscopy 2008, 67:791-795
Therapy:
## Preferred Prophylaxis:

[Cefazolin Weight Based Dosing Preop](surg-cefazolin-weight-based-dosing)

## Alternative for patient with severe penicillin allergy:

Clindamycin 600 mg IV over 30 minutes beginning 60 minutes
before incision ($$) [H,O]
